text.p: These are the leading stories in the Algerian press on Thursday as reported by the official Algerian news agency APS. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Security forces kill Armed Islamic Group (GIA)'s local leader Amara Yacine and seven of his followers in their hideout in the Casbah of Algiers.
- Delegates at the five-day national economic conference debate housing and agricultural policies.
- The Transitional National Council holds session to vote state budget for 1997 and hear an assessment of the country's financial situation by the central bank chief.

- Former ruling National Liberation Front (FLN) convenes its central committee policy-making body to discuss the party congress after general elections, planned for first half of next year, and participation in the government.
